description: This file generates a report of student and guardian contact details for an educational institution, including student info, guardian info, and associated roll numbers.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the student and guardian contact details report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report.

methods.name: get_student_details
methods.description: Retrieves detailed student information for a list of student IDs.

methods.name: get_guardian_map
methods.description: Builds a mapping of students to their guardians with contact info.

methods.name: get_student_roll_no
methods.description: Fetches roll numbers for students in a specific academic year, program, and batch.
